'''Shalath''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and [[Sith alchemist/Legends|Sith alchemist]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the Sith capital [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] she was camped near the rogue Sith Lord [[Grathan]]'s [[Lord Grathan's estate|estate]] where she sent several [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolytes]] with [[Sith runes]] to bind a [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] created by [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]]. The acolytes were killed by the spawn and so Shalath hired several other Imperials to recover the Runes and complete the task.

==Behind the scenes==
According to the game files for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', Shalath was originally named "Lord Sunder." She was also involved in a cut quest given by Apprentice [[Frun]], whose master was engaged in a [[Kaggath]] with Shalath. Frun would have asked players to deliver a message to Shalath's apprentice [[Maraad]].
